items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: He was a good drummer. (Unintelligible). That was Robichaux's

ctx.x: Robichaux. They all -- they used to call me The Kid. "Let's get The Kid." All them bass players was coming over to me and stick me up on that stand, you understand, to play. And I played, and they'd shake their heads. I'm growing fast. And I was growing fast, if I have to say it myself. Done fine with the Eagle Band, I done fine with the Crescent Band -- Jack Corey's band, that is.
